content:
**Deliverable Files**

| File | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `FEASIBILITY_ARCHITECTURE.md` | markdown | Human‑readable full product architecture, POC architecture, diagrams, cost models, security, testing, API strategy, deployment topology, and compliance. |
| `FEASIBILITY_ARCHITECTURE.json` | json | Structured representation of the same information for downstream tooling. |
| `03_architect_agent_COMPLETION_SLIDE.pptx` | pptx | Summary slide deck (key deliverables, timelines, cost, scaling, testing, and next steps). |
| `03_architect_agent_DATA_EXPORT.xlsx` | xlsx | Tabular export of cost models, scaling thresholds, and resource estimates. |
| `DIAGRAMS.md` | markdown | All Mermaid diagram code blocks referenced in the architecture (system context, container, component, data‑flow, deployment, POC scope). |
| `COST_MODELS.md` | markdown | Detailed cost tables for POC and each production scaling tier. |
| `GUARDRAIL_VERIFICATION.md` | markdown | Confirmation that all mandatory guardrails are satisfied. |
| `POC_SCOPE.md` | markdown | Explicit mapping of POC requirements to the full architecture. |

The files have been written to the agent sandbox at `agents/02_engineering_specs/03_architect_agent/`.

items.check: API gateway with rate-limiting rules defined
POC scope clearly maps to subset of full architecture (POC_SCOPE.md)
infrastructure cost model accounts for scaling thresholds (COST_MODELS.md)
